# Modern Quilt Designer 0.10.0 Preview

Phase 2 brings editable `.mqd` projects, a direct construction canvas, reusable parametric blocks and a page-based project notebook.

- Save projects with managed folders, portable fabric/reference assets, Recent Projects, backups and recovery. Earlier project formats remain supported.
- Drag blocks from the library, select and group multiple objects, lock, copy, transform, align and resize using physical measurements. Edit in inches/fractions, millimeters or centimeters with shared Undo/Redo.
- Create Dresden Plate and Mariner’s Compass designs from editable parameters. Reopen and continue adjusting them, save them to My Blocks, or deliberately convert them into normal editable pieces.
- Build a Letter or A4 notebook with flowing text, images, swatches, diagrams and project information; export matching PDF pages.
- Use Guided Setup and Designer on the same project. Preview target-size alternatives and cutting consequences before applying major changes.
- A clearer blank drawing field, compact block-library controls and improved light/dark contrast keep the work area easy to identify.

To update an existing copy, open **Settings → About & Updates**, choose **Preview / Development**, then **Check for updates** and download/install. The public download contains the Windows installer and update signature; application source remains private.

This is a development preview. Radial curves use documented deterministic approximations; narrow/sharp seam allowances and unsupported assemblies can still block cutting. Generated pieces do not supply an automatic sewing or foundation-paper-piecing sequence. Notebook editing uses semantic content blocks. Please test-print at actual size and sew a sample before relying on a new template for a full quilt.
